scope: Analyses start from processed mutation/CNV matrices and documented derived inputs. Upstream FASTQ, variant-calling, CNV inference, signature extraction, and copy-number clustering are not rerun here.

descriptive_PCA.SNV_preprocessing: binary; frequency computed within each displayed cohort
descriptive_PCA.CNV_preprocessing: raw arithmetic cluster-mean log2 ratio; no variance scaling
descriptive_PCA.solver: full; matches legacy auto effective solver for all four current matrix sizes

exploratory_feature_test.test: Friedman test across A/T/S within each patient

S9_x_axis.final_definition: mean across cases of (abs(A-T) + abs(T-S) + abs(S-A)) / 3

subtype_CNV.correction: Benjamini-Hochberg separately across features for the overall test and for each pairwise comparison

similarity.CNV_similarity: cosine similarity; retain signed theoretical range unless a figure-specific definition specifies otherwise

S7_within_between_inference.status: pending audit of independent unit and dependence-aware test

shared_private_variant_definition.shared: present in matched A, T and S
shared_private_variant_definition.A-only: present in A but not matched S; T not excluded
shared_private_variant_definition.S-only: present in S but not matched A; T not excluded

pooled_CCA_S18A_tables3_4.status: confirmed; independently reproduced in standalone Step 07a

CNV.standardization: StandardScaler fitted across the 200 pooled T samples before PCA

pooled_CCA_S18A_tables3_4.coefficient_units: SNV binary-feature back-projection and standardized CNV-cluster-feature coefficients
pooled_CCA_S18A_tables3_4.verification: top 10 rows and rankings in latest manuscript Tables 3 and 4 matched at 3 decimals

reference_only_CCA_S18B_C.status: retained reference fit, displayed in merged S18B
reference_only_CCA_S18B_C.current_rule: LUAD/LUSC-only PCA/CCA fit; all 13977 mutation features; CNV is not variance-standardized before PCA; CCA scale=true
reference_only_CCA_S18B_C.ASC_role: project after fitting the reference-only transformations

classifier.design: retrospective stratified 80/20 internal holdout of 171 LUAD/LUSC reference patients

split.reproducible_order: sort reference patient/sample IDs before the stratified split

feature_selection.RFE: RFECV is refit inside each training fold

classifier.final_model_fit_scope: development 136 only; holdout is not added back; ASC is scored after model selection
limitations: retrospective internal holdout, not an external validation cohort
the frozen 114-cluster representation was derived from the full 171-patient reference set and therefore includes holdout-derived information

S20_importance: standalone model importance averaged across five folds per seed; unselected features contribute zero; top 20 features ranked by mean importance; not final-stacking coefficients
not_resolved_by_this_specification: dependence-aware inference for repeated pairwise and CV comparisons
